mapper.select: SELECT * FROM banks WHERE bank_id = #{bankId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banks (bank_id, bank_name, region_code, bank_geometry, description, reversed, user_id) VALUES (#{bankId}, #{bankName}, #{regionCode}, #{bankGeometry}::jsonb, #{description}, #{reversed}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE banks SET bank_name = #{bankName}, region_code = #{regionCode}, bank_geometry = #{bankGeometry}::jsonb, description = #{description}, reversed = #{reversed} WHERE bank_id = #{bankId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
UPDATE banks SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bank_id = #{bankId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
